findings.finding: Tread spacing is nearly uniform from bottom to top; the promised foreshortening (upper steps thinner/darker) is barely perceptible, so at 1x the flight reads partly as a ladder/rack of evenly spaced bars between two full-height rails.
findings.fix: Make the bottom two treads 3px tall, middle 2px, top two 1px with the riser line 1px throughout; step each tread one palette shade darker going north (lightest stone at the bottom, mid stone at the top).

findings.finding: The landing's dark front face is a thin strip and the landing reads only ~1 tile deep under the balustrade; the 'raised' quality comes mostly from the balustrade, not from a visible drop/shadow onto the floor beside the stair top.
findings.fix: Extend the landing front face to 2px of darkest stone on both sides of the stair top and add a 1px darker floor-shadow row directly below it on the east side, continuing the east wedge shadow.

findings.finding: A north balustrade closes the landing, so the stair ends at a railing with no visible onward exit; reads as a balcony/dais rather than a transfer.
findings.fix: Open the centre 6-8px of the north balustrade (keep newels) and fill it with a near-black void or a dark arched opening so the path continues north.

findings.finding: The east/west balustrades are single thin light lines with no balusters, so the three-sided rail reads as a picture/vent frame at 1x rather than a railing; only the north side has posts.
findings.fix: Give the west and east rails 1px light top + 1px dark shadow and 2-3 visible baluster dots each, matching the north balustrade's post rhythm.

findings.finding: Darkness gradient is correct (near-black north, light south) but the lower treads are almost the same grey as the lip, so the first drop below the lip is not emphasised.
findings.fix: Insert a 1px near-black shadow row directly under the light south lip before the first tread.

findings.finding: In the shipped 시계탑 기어실 the flight stands free on the floor and ends at an iron-mesh landing closed by a railing on its north side, with nothing beyond it (no hatch, no wall opening, no ceiling void). An ordinary player reads it as a dead-end mezzanine/platform, not as a transfer upward; the checker mesh plus rail also reads at 1x as a grille/cage top.
findings.fix: Replace the north railing centre with an open dark hatch void (near-black 8x4 opening with a 1px iron rim lit on the top-left) or move the piece so the landing meets the north wall with a dark doorway; reduce the checker mesh to a 2-tone diagonal pattern with a lit 1px front edge so it reads as a walkable floor plate.

findings.finding: Oak treads and risers are near-identical brown stripes of constant height; tread planes vs riser faces are weakly separated, so the flight resembles the flat crate of the BEFORE art.
findings.fix: Lighten tread tops by one shade with a 1px highlight on the upper-left, darken risers by two shades, and taper tread height toward the landing.

findings.finding: The warm-lit top steps are bright near-white/yellow stripes under a pink-orange block; at 1x in the shop this reads as a glowing heater/radiator or fireplace (the same misreading the BEFORE art had) rather than light falling down a stairwell.
findings.fix: Lower the lit treads to the warm wood highlight tone (not cream), keep the riser lines dark, and replace the pink-orange block with a dark doorway top showing a soft warm gradient that fades downward over 3-4px.

findings.finding: The stair wood is the same brown as the flanking bookshelves, so at 1x the stair blends into the shelving wall.
findings.fix: Darken the door frame posts by one shade and add a 1px near-black inner reveal between frame and treads to separate it from the shelves.

findings.finding: Stone treads are uniformly grey with weak tread/riser contrast; straw and droppings flecks are noisy single bright pixels that read as sparkle/noise.
findings.fix: Darken risers two shades, cluster straw into 2-3px yellow-brown tufts on tread edges, limit white droppings to 2 pixels total.

findings.finding: Ends against a north wooden rail with no onward opening (same dead-end reading as the castle up stair); not shipped in a place now, so lower impact.
findings.fix: Open the rail centre to a dark void/doorway.

findings.finding: The single white dropping pixel on the south lip and the olive flecks read as stray noise; the side rails are thin and lack the post rhythm of the north rail.
findings.fix: Remove or dim the white pixel to the light straw tone; add 2 baluster posts on each side rail.

places.finding: 시계탑 기어실: wz-clock-stair at (1,10) sits free on the floor beside the west wall and ends at a railed mesh landing with nothing above it; the transfer upward is not legible (counted as the clock-stair major above, not double-counted).
places.fix: See wz-clock-stair: open the landing to a dark hatch/void or connect it to a dark wall opening.

places.finding: Honeydukes: the stair sits correctly in the north wall between the shelves with no broken wall seams, but the bottom newels/handrails land flush on the wall-base row, so the step from wall face to floor row has no shadow.
places.fix: Add a 1px dark floor-shadow row under the wall base on both sides of the bottom stair row.

places.finding: 부엉이 탑: the down stairwell at (1,8) reads correctly as a hole going down and does not cut the wall; fine apart from the per-piece polish notes.
